records.en: ◆ Your private collection exhibits the precious gifts you've gathered from various places in this world. Each exhibit embodies affection and friendship, reflecting the profound bonds you've built with others.
◆ The exhibits in this hall need to be accepted by Bubo to be displayed. After being accepted, these exhibits will bring improvements to Transcenders.
◆ You can choose on which stands you want to place your exhibits in this hall.
◆ You can remove the exhibits from the display stands, and they will still provide improvements.
